- matches_caret does not reject prerelease versions without allow_prerelease=True flag
- 2 worktree tests pass with 0 failures and diff shows 16 insertions across 2 files
SUGGESTED CHECK: verify presence of parse_semver_tag implementation and allow_prerelease logic in src/caret_spec.py
